lines.en: label rinspring2:
scene rinsara1
And our segment focusing on Rin Rokuhara begins.
lines.zh: 我们聚焦在 Rin Rokuhara 身上的这一段，就此开始。

lines.en: : Yo!

Rin Rokuhara, locally renowned bisexual, had been feeling rather conflicted lately. But I’m less inclined to compare her to an elder beast foraging for berries and {i}more{/i} inclined to just {i}compare{/i} her.
lines.zh: Rin Rokuhara，当地有名的双性恋，最近心里相当矛盾。不过我不太想把她比作一头在林子里觅食浆果的年长野兽，我{i}更{/i}愿意就只是拿她来做{i}比较{/i}。

lines.en: She wasn’t as [[successfully] outgoing as Chika Chosokabe. Nor did she possess the unabashed kindness demonstrated on a routine basis by her roommate Futaba Fukuyama.
lines.zh: 她没有 Chika Chosokabe 那么[[成功地]外向。她也不具备室友 Futaba Fukuyama 日常展现出的那种毫不掩饰的善良。

lines.en: But she {i}did{/i} have something that set her apart from both of them.
lines.zh: 但她{i}确实{/i}有某样东西，让她和她们两个都不一样。

lines.en: A cool, skull-shaped hairpin that she bought from a discount store at the mall that she has decorated her many different hairstyles with ever since.
lines.zh: 一枚很酷的骷髅形发夹，是她从商场里的折扣店买来的，从那以后她用过的每一种发型都拿它来点缀。

lines.en: It wasn’t perfect. And she wished there could be something a little more impressive about her when compared to everyone else, but she was fine with being mostly unremarkable.
lines.zh: 它并不完美。她也希望自己相比其他人能有一点更出彩的地方，但对于大体上平平无奇这点，她并不介意。

lines.en: She was {i}fine{/i} with taking the backseat, as evidenced quite literally by her claiming the stereotypical “protagonist’s chair” in the back corner of the classroom on the first day of school.
lines.zh: 她{i}甘愿{/i}退居次席——这点在开学第一天就被字面地印证了：她霸占了教室后排角落那把典型的「主角专座」。

lines.en: If she was going to be ordinary, she would be the most spectacular ordinary person she could be.
lines.zh: 既然注定平凡，那她就要做自己所能做到的、最耀眼的那个平凡人。

lines.en: Only in short bursts, though, as it didn’t take long as the center of attention for her to start crumbling.
lines.zh: 当然只能是一阵一阵的，因为只要成为众人目光的焦点，用不了多久她就会开始崩塌。

lines.en: And to revisit what I mentioned just moments ago about her currently being {i}conflicted,{/i} conflict as a whole was the whole idea conflicting her. Do you follow?
lines.zh: 再回到我几分钟前说起过的、她当下正感到{i}矛盾{/i}这件事——让她矛盾的，恰恰是「矛盾」这个概念本身。你听懂了吗？

lines.en: No? Then allow to me put it in plainer terms.
lines.zh: 没有？那就容我说得更直白一点。

lines.en: Rin Rokuhara didn’t like what she was currently feeling. And that really pissed her off because it wasn’t every day she got to feel anything at all.
lines.zh: Rin Rokuhara 不喜欢自己此刻的感受。这让她相当恼火，毕竟她可不是每天都有机会真正感受到点什么。

lines.en: She was bitter, but not {i}too{/i} bitter about the break-up. She didn’t mind that the collective mindset of her class was rapidly deteriorating. She just wanted to stop being jealous.
lines.zh: 分手这件事她心里有疙瘩，但也没{i}那么{/i}疙瘩。班上整体的氛围在迅速恶化，她也不在乎。她只是想别再嫉妒了。

lines.en: Because if {i}she{/i} began to want what everyone else wanted, it would only make things harder. And she was finally in a good spot.
lines.zh: 因为一旦{i}她{/i}开始想要别人都想要的东西，事情只会变得更难。而她好不容易才走到一个不错的位置上。

lines.en: But as she stepped into the cafe, she subconsciously scanned the room for someone she knew would not be there.
lines.zh: 可当她踏进咖啡厅时，她还是下意识地扫视了一圈，寻找那个她明知不会在场的人。

lines.en: And {i}this{/i} is why she was feeling conflicted.
lines.zh: 而{i}这{/i}就是她感到矛盾的原因。

lines.en: Because it meant what she didn’t want it to mean.
lines.zh: 因为它意味着，她并不想让它意味的那个意思。

lines.en: scene black
scene rinsara2
: Yeah. Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 嗯。这样可以吗？

lines.en: : You know where the keys are, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道钥匙在哪儿，对吧？

lines.en: : Sorry to interrupt your call, but I need to-
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断你打电话，但我需要——

lines.en: : Rin, hold on. Sorry, can you say that again?
lines.zh: : Rin，等一下。抱歉，你能再说一遍吗？

lines.en: scene rinsara3
: No, they’re next to the stove in a wicker basket.
lines.zh: : 不是，在炉子旁边的一个柳条筐里。

lines.en: : {i}Wicker.{/i} It's that weird...straw stuff. How do you not know what wicker is?
lines.zh: : {i}柳条。{/i}就是那种怪怪的……草编的东西。你怎么会不知道柳条是什么？

lines.en: scene rinsara4
: Just look in the basket. You {i}do{/i} remember how to drive, right?
lines.zh: : 就在筐里找找。你总{i}还{/i}记得怎么开车吧？

lines.en: : If you are lying to me right now-
lines.zh: : 如果你现在是在骗我——

lines.en: : Yeah. Next Sunday. Got it.
lines.zh: : 嗯。下周日。明白了。

lines.en: scene rinsara5
: I’m sending one of my girls to help you right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就派我手下一个姑娘过去帮你。

lines.en: : You’re doing what?
lines.zh: : 你要干什么？

lines.en: : Can you pick her up here? Or-
lines.zh: : 你能在这儿接她吗？或者——

lines.en: : What? Why not?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么不行？

lines.en: : Hellooo? Haruka? Your employee of the month would like to clock in now.
lines.zh: : 喂——喂？Haruka？你的本月最佳员工想现在就打卡上班了。

lines.en: : Fine. Whatever. Just...hold on. I have to tell Rin.
lines.zh: : 行吧。随便了。只是……等一下。我得去跟 Rin 说。

lines.en: scene rinsara6
: Rin, I need your help with something.
lines.zh: : Rin，我有件事需要你帮忙。

lines.en: : Is that something...making coffee? Because my skill-set is pretty limited and that’s all I get paid to do.
lines.zh: : 那件事是……煮咖啡吗？因为我的技能点相当有限，而我拿钱也就只干这个。

lines.en: : No. One of our brewers stopped working and I need you to go with a friend of mine to pick a new one up. And don’t forget to get a receipt or it’s coming out of your paycheck.
lines.zh: : 不是。我们有一台咖啡机坏了，我要你跟我一个朋友去取台新的。别忘了要收据，不然就从你工资里扣。

lines.en: scene rinsara7
: What? Me? Why me? Why can’t your friend just do it if she’s already going?
lines.zh: : 什么？我？为什么是我？既然她反正都要去，为什么不能让她自己去？

lines.en: : Because I don’t trust her to get the right one and you can’t drive yet.
lines.zh: : 因为我不信她能买对型号，而你又还不会开车。

lines.en: scene rinsara8
: Hm? Oh, no. You heard that correctly. I said I didn’t trust you.
lines.zh: : 嗯？哦，没错。你没听错。我说的是我不信任你。

lines.en: : Obviously because I don’t trust you. But yeah. I’m sending her now. Just make sure to tell me where you’re picking her up since you refuse to come here for some reason.
lines.zh: : 显然就是因为我信不过你。总之。我现在就让她过去。你记得到时候告诉我在哪儿接她，毕竟你不知为什么死活不肯过来。

lines.en: : Got it. Thanks. Bye.
lines.zh: : 知道了。谢了。拜。

lines.en: scene rinsara9
: Okay. Sorry. Crazy night. Let me write down the model number and-
lines.zh: : 好了。抱歉。今晚太乱了。让我把型号写下来，然后——

lines.en: scene rinsara10
: What’s wrong? Why do you look so sad? Shouldn’t you be excited to get out of work? We’re slammed tonight.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你为什么一脸难过？能溜出店里不该开心吗？我们今晚可是忙疯了。

lines.en: : Hell yeah we are, which means it’s the best time to show you what I’m made of. How am I supposed to fight for a promotion if I’m spending my time {i}away{/i} from the store? Just have Molly do it.
lines.zh: : 忙疯了才对，也就是说现在正是让你见识我本事的最好时机。我要是老待在店{i}外面{/i}，还怎么去争取升职？让 Molly 去不就行了。

lines.en: : Molly called out. Something about a...{i}Pal-{/i}world? Do you know what that is? Some kind of convention?
lines.zh: : Molly 请假了。说什么……{i}Pal-{/i}world？你知道那是什么吗？某种展会？

lines.en: scene rinsara11
: Oh, that fucking bitch.
lines.zh: : 哦，那个混蛋。

lines.en: : Whatever the case, do this and you can have the promotion. Nobody else is qualified anyway.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，把这事儿办了，升职就是你的。反正也没别人够格。

lines.en: scene rinsara12
: Wait, really?!
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？！

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ll start training you on paperwork later tonight.
lines.zh: : 真的。我今晚晚点就开始教你做文书。

lines.en: : And, just to clarify, this promotion includes a raise, right?
lines.zh: : 还有，确认一下，这次升职是包括加薪的，对吧？

lines.en: : Obviously. I just have to run some numbers and-
lines.zh: : 当然。我得先算几个数——

lines.en: scene rinsara13
: Wait, we’ll talk about this later. I need you out of here {i}now.{/i}
lines.zh: : 等等，这个回头再说。我现在就需要你{i}马上{/i}离开这儿。

lines.en: : Got it! I still don’t know where I’m going, though.
lines.zh: : 明白！不过我还不知道要去哪儿呢。

lines.en: : Neither do I. Just pick a direction and...run that way while I follow up with my friend. Worse comes to worst, you have to turn around.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。随便挑个方向，然后……往那边跑，我这边再跟我朋友跟进。最坏的情况，也就是你再掉头回来。

lines.en: : Choose a direction and run! Got it!
lines.zh: : 选个方向然后跑！明白！

lines.en: scene black
: Wait! Leave your bag here. It’ll weigh you down.
lines.zh: : 等等！把包留在这儿。它会拖累你。

lines.en: : Roger!
lines.zh: : 收到！

lines.en: And so Rin Rokuhara takes off in an undisclosed and random direction...
lines.zh: 于是 Rin Rokuhara 朝着一个不明且随机的方向冲了出去……

lines.en: scene nightsky
Which, of course, winds up being the {i}wrong{/i} direction. And she then has to turn around after two minutes of sprinting.
lines.zh: 当然，那是个{i}错误{/i}的方向。冲刺了两分钟之后，她不得不掉头往回跑。

lines.en: Twenty minutes go by...and the brisk air of a spring night enters her lungs as she breathes a shallow sigh of relief at the prospect of being able to inhale without burning up from the inside out.
lines.zh: 二十分钟过去了……春夜的清冷空气灌进她的肺里，她浅浅地舒了一口气——至少现在呼吸时，不用再从里到外被烧着了。

lines.en: She was glad summer had reached its end. And she was glad that she could take this season as an opportunity to start over.
lines.zh: 她庆幸夏天终于结束。也庆幸能把这个季节当作重新开始的机会。

lines.en: scene rinsara14
: Hah...hah...hah...
“But where do I start {i}from?”{/i} she wondered, sweat trickling down her chest as the night air fought to cool her down.
lines.zh: 「该{i}从{/i}哪里开始呢？」她心想，汗水顺着胸口往下淌，夜风正努力替她降温。

lines.en: “What are my goals? What do I {i}want?{/i}”
lines.zh: 「我的目标是什么？我{i}想要什么？{/i}」

lines.en: The promotion was already a lock unless Haruka changed her mind. So Rin needed to come up with something else or face the fact that, for the first time in her life, she’d have nothing to chase after.
lines.zh: 除非 Haruka 改主意，升职已经是板上钉钉。所以 Rin 得再想点别的，否则就得面对一个事实：有生以来第一次，她将没有任何东西可以追逐。

lines.en: scene rinsara15
Nothing attainable at least. But it wasn’t all that long ago that she wholeheartedly believed finding a girlfriend was a feat so far out of reach that words like “plausible” would make her laugh.
lines.zh: 至少没有够得着的东西。但就在不久之前，她还由衷地以为交到女朋友是件遥不可及的事，遥不可及到「有可能」这种词都会让她发笑。

lines.en: She avoided making eye contact with the stars as she worried it would motivate her to shoot for them.
lines.zh: 她避开与星星对视，生怕那会撺掇自己去摘星。

lines.en: And as a distant voice approached from beyond the darkness, she decided it would be best to keep these thoughts buried in the back of her head for now.
lines.zh: 当黑暗的那一头传来一个渐近的遥远声音时，她决定暂时把这些念头埋在脑海深处为好。

lines.en: Just...she worried that she wouldn’t be able to force them back as far as they’d been before.
lines.zh: 只是……她担心自己没法再像从前那样，把它们压得那么深。

lines.en: For they had always been there, but they’d never been this violent. And they’d never been this desperate.
lines.zh: 因为它们一直都在，只是从未如此凶猛，也从未如此不顾一切。

lines.en: Her eyes scan her surroundings once more, but it’s hopeless.
lines.zh: 她再次扫视一圈四周，但毫无希望。

lines.en: : Oh! Okay, I see her. I think. Maybe?
lines.zh: : 哦！好，我看到她了。大概。也许？

lines.en: scene rinsara16
: Did she bleach her hair? I don’t remember- actually. Hold on. I’ll just ask.
lines.zh: : 她把头发漂染了吗？我不记得了——算了。等等。我直接问吧。

lines.en: scene rinsara17
: Hi! Rin, right?
lines.zh: : 你好！你是 Rin，对吧？

lines.en: : Sana’s...mom?
lines.zh: : Sana 的……妈妈？

lines.en: scene rinsara18
: Yup! The eagle has landed, Haru-chan. I will now be hanging up the telephone.
lines.zh: : 没错！鹰已着陆，Haru-chan。我现在要挂电话了。

lines.en: : And thanks again for letting me borrow your car! A thing I totally did!
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢你把车借给我！这事儿我可真干了！

lines.en: : Nope! Sorry! Going through a tunnel! In your car! Bye!
lines.zh: : 不！抱歉！要过隧道了！开着你车过的！拜！

lines.en: scene rinsara19
: Whoops. I accidentally hung up.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我不小心挂断了。

lines.en: scene rinsara20
: Hi! You can call me Sara, not “Sana’s mom.”
lines.zh: : 你好！叫我 Sara 就行，别叫「Sana 的妈妈」。

lines.en: : Heeey. And...you can call me Rin. Because...that is my name. My name is Rin.
lines.zh: : 嘿——嘿。还有……你可以叫我 Rin。因为……那就是我的名字。我的名字是 Rin。

lines.en: scene rinsara21
: It sure is.
lines.zh: : 确实是。

lines.en: : Well, this is awkward.
lines.zh: : 啊，这气氛真尴尬。

lines.en: : I don’t normally hang out with my daughter’s friends. And whenever I do, my daughter is typically...you know...present.
lines.zh: : 我平时不怎么和我女儿的朋友混在一起。就算有，我女儿通常也……你知道的……在场。

lines.en: : Y-Yeah...But...we’re not technically {i}hanging out.{/i} This is a business thing. We’ve gotta...go...touch a machine. With our hands.
lines.zh: : 是、是啊……不过……严格来说我们不算{i}在玩。{/i}这是公事。我们得……去……摸一台机器。用手摸。

lines.en: : Yeah, about that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，关于这个嘛。

lines.en: : No we don’t.
lines.zh: : 不，我们不需要。

lines.en: scene rinsara22
: I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : Haru-chan said some guy in a purple hat fixed the machine for her, so we don’t need to go and buy a new one now.
lines.zh: : Haru-chan 说有个戴紫色帽子的男人帮她把机器修好了，所以现在我们不用去买新的了。

lines.en: : So...we came all the way here for nothing?
lines.zh: : 所以……我们大老远跑来是白跑了？

lines.en: scene rinsara23
: Hey, at least you ran! I had to take a taxi here and now I’m out like 4,000 yen.
lines.zh: : 嘿，至少你跑了！我得打车过来，现在搭进去差不多 4000 日元。

lines.en: : Taxi? I thought Haruka was letting you borrow her car?
lines.zh: : 打车？我还以为 Haruka 把车借给你了？

lines.en: : She was! But she’s also under the impression that I know how to drive when I’ve only been behind the wheel of a car a few times in my life and they’ve all been absolutely terrifying.
lines.zh: : 她是借了！可她还以为我会开车，而我这辈子只摸过几次方向盘，而且每次都吓得要命。

lines.en: scene rinsara24
: Why didn’t you just tell her that? She would have called us both a taxi if she knew.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不直接告诉她？她要是知道，早就给我们俩都叫一辆出租车了。

lines.en: : Because now she thinks I’m cooler since I know how to drive.
lines.zh: : 因为现在她觉得我很酷，毕竟我会开车嘛。

lines.en: : But you don’t know how to-
lines.zh: : 可你根本不会开——

lines.en: scene rinsara25
: Shhhh...that will be our little secret.
lines.zh: : 嘘……这就当是我们俩的小秘密。

lines.en: : Well...does this mean I have to run all the way back to the cafe? Because I don’t have enough money on me to pay for a taxi and I’m not going to make my friend’s mom buy me one.
lines.zh: : 那……这是不是意味着我得一路跑回咖啡厅？因为我身上没那么多钱打车，而且我也不可能让朋友的妈妈给我掏车钱。

lines.en: scene rinsara26
: But what if I buy {i}myself{/i} a taxi over to Koi Cafe and you just happen to...also get inside of it? That would work, right?
lines.zh: : 那要是{i}我自己{/i}叫辆出租车去 Koi Cafe，而你正好……也坐了进去呢？这样就行了吧？

lines.en: : But if we show up in a taxi, Haruka will know that-
lines.zh: : 可要是我们坐着出租车出现，Haruka 就会知道——

lines.en: : So we have them stop a block away! You need to learn to start thinking outside of the box if you’re ever going to convince people you’re cooler than you actually are, Rin. Take it from me.
lines.zh: : 那就让他们在一个街区外停下！Rin，你要是想让别人相信你比实际更酷，就得学会跳出框框想问题。听我的没错。

lines.en: scene rinsara27
: No, I get it. I keep a skateboard in my dorm and I don’t even know how to ollie.
lines.zh: : 不，我懂。我宿舍里放了块滑板，而我连 ollie 都不会。

lines.en: : And I don’t even know what an ollie is so we’re already on the same page!
lines.zh: : 我连 ollie 是什么都不知道，所以我们已经想到一块儿去了！

lines.en: scene rinsara28
: We’re the same height too and it’s kind of making me uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 我们俩一样高，这让我有点不自在。

lines.en: : But it’s making {i}me{/i} feel young and that’s all that really matters.
lines.zh: : 但这让{i}我{/i}觉得自己年轻了，而这才是最重要的。

lines.en: : So...I guess we just...go back now? And this whole trip was pointless? And I lose my promotion because Haruka sees it as a loophole and realizes I accomplished nothing tonight?
lines.zh: : 所以……我想我们这就……回去了？这一趟算是白跑了？而且 Haruka 会觉得这是个空子，发现我今晚什么也没干成，然后我的升职就吹了？

lines.en: scene rinsara29
: Oh, stop. Haru-chan wouldn’t do something like that to you. I’ve heard her talk about you plenty of times before and I can assure you that basically all of it has been good.
lines.zh: : 哦，别这么说。Haru-chan 不会对你做那种事的。我之前听过她提起你很多次，我可以向你保证，基本上全都是好话。

lines.en: : {i}Basically{/i} all of it?
lines.zh: : {i}基本上{/i}？

lines.en: : She’s mentioned that you can get a little distracted when cute girls show up but, let’s face it, don’t we {i}all?{/i}
lines.zh: : 她提过你一见到可爱女生就有点分心，不过说真的，{i}谁不是{/i}呢？

lines.en: : To be completely honest, it’s taking everything I have to even form complete sentences in front of you right now.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我现在光是在你面前把话说完整，就已经用尽全力了。

lines.en: : Because I’m young and beautiful, right? Say it. Tell me I’m young and beautiful.
lines.zh: : 因为我年轻又漂亮，对吧？说嘛。说我年轻又漂亮。

lines.en: : I’m not sure I can do that without getting a nosebleed.
lines.zh: : 我不确定说完之后会不会流鼻血。

lines.en: scene black
: Booooooo. This way!
lines.zh: : 呿——走这边！

lines.en: : Wait! Sana’s mom!
lines.zh: : 等等！Sana 的妈妈！

lines.en: : {i}Sara!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sara！{/i}

lines.en: : S-Sara! Where are you going?! I thought we were calling a taxi?
lines.zh: : S-Sara！你要去哪儿？！我们还不是要叫出租车吗？

lines.en: : It’ll be faster from the park! Trust me! I’ve been pretending to be cool longer than you’ve been alive!
lines.zh: : 从公园走更快！相信我！我装酷的时候，你还没出生呢！

lines.en: And so two unlikely girls, forced together by the swift hands of a woman with massive breasts, make their way to a nearby park.
lines.zh: 于是，两个八竿子打不到一块儿的女孩，被一个巨乳女人麻利的手硬凑到一起，动身前往附近的公园。

lines.en: scene rinsara30
It is a park where strange things have occurred on several occasions before. And, believe it or not, these two bear a special connection to the girl those strange things have revolved around.
lines.zh: 那是一座此前发生过好几次怪事的公园。而且，信不信由你，这两个人都与那些怪事所围绕的那个女孩有着特殊的牵连。

lines.en: As they sit on a bench and wait for a taxi to arrive, the pressure begins to mount. They know they’re supposed to be talking right now. But what are they supposed to talk {i}about?{/i}
lines.zh: 两人坐在长椅上等出租车，压力开始积聚。她们知道此刻应该聊点什么。可该聊{i}什么{/i}呢？

lines.en: And why is it so difficult when they have so much in common?
lines.zh: 明明有那么多共同点，为什么却这么难开口？

lines.en: Neither one can ollie. Neither one can drive. Even the fantasies that enshroud their minds when they touch themselves are similar.
lines.zh: 两个人都不会 ollie。两个人都不会开车。就连自慰时脑海里萦绕的那些幻想都差不多。

lines.en: It wouldn’t be right to talk about those, though. Not during their first meeting on this bench at least. Something like that would have to wait until the third or fourth or fifth time.
lines.zh: 不过聊那些就不太合适了。至少在长椅上第一次见面时不合适。那种事得等到第三、第四或者第五次再说。

lines.en: : Do I make you uncomfortable, Rin?
lines.zh: : 我让你不自在吗，Rin？

lines.en: One of them was used to breaking awkward silences like this. But despite how many times she’d done it before, she had never gotten {i}good{/i} at it.
lines.zh: 其中一个人早已习惯打破这种尴尬的沉默。可尽管做过那么多次，她始终没能变得{i}擅长{/i}。

lines.en: scene rinsara31
: Huh? Not really. Why?
lines.zh: : 啊？没有啊。为什么这么问？

lines.en: Regardless of that, though, she tried.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，她还是试了。

lines.en: : Just wanted to make sure. I’ve been told I can come off a little strong before. And I can imagine it’s already kind of weird to be chatting with your friend’s mom in the first place.
lines.zh: : 就是想确认一下。以前有人说过我有时候给人压力挺大的。而且我也能想象，光是跟朋友的妈妈聊天本身就挺怪的。

lines.en: : It’s not {i}that{/i} weird. I have like, twice the amount of experience when it comes to talking to moms that most people do. I’d be way more uncomfortable if you were Sana’s dad.
lines.zh: : 也没{i}那么{/i}怪。跟妈妈们打交道的经验，我大概比大多数人多一倍。如果你是 Sana 的爸爸，我才会更不自在。

lines.en: scene rinsara32
: Well, that’s reassuring to hear. Because I was about your age when I first met him and I was definitely {i}not{/i} uncomfortable despite the...admittedly massive age gap.
lines.zh: : 哦，听你这么说我就放心了。因为我第一次遇见他的时候差不多就是你这么大，而且说实话，尽管年龄差距……确实很大，我也完全{i}没{/i}觉得不自在。

lines.en: : He was older than you? By how much?
lines.zh: : 他比你大？大多少？

lines.en: scene rinsara33
: A lot. He was my teacher. But I was pretty attention-starved back then, so that didn’t really matter to me.
lines.zh: : 大很多。他是我的老师。但那时候我极度缺爱，所以那对我来说并不要紧。

lines.en: : Your teacher? Really?
lines.zh: : 你的老师？真的？

lines.en: : Mhm. I was a freshman in high school. Just like you now.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。我当时是高一。就跟你现在一样。

lines.en: : Do you...do you regret it? Looking back on it now?
lines.zh: : 你……你后悔吗？现在回头看的话？

lines.en: : Why would I regret it? I got the world’s most adorable little girl out of the deal, so I think it’s pretty safe to say I came out on top. Even {i}if{/i} I had to raise her on my own.
lines.zh: : 我为什么要后悔？这笔买卖让我得到了世界上最可爱的小女儿，所以我可以很肯定地说，我赚到了。{i}哪怕{/i}我得独自把她拉扯大。

lines.en: scene rinsara34
: Was it hard?
lines.zh: : 很辛苦吧？

lines.en: : Oh god, yeah. I still have no idea how I managed. But Sana turned out perfectly, so I guess I didn’t make {i}too{/i} many mistakes.
lines.zh: : 天啊，是的。我到现在都不知道自己是怎么撑过来的。但 Sana 长成了这么好的样子，所以我猜我也没犯{i}太{/i}多错。

lines.en: : Let’s not talk about {i}me,{/i} though. My story’s long and confusing, and I want to know more about you. Sana doesn’t really open up much when it comes to her friends.
lines.zh: : 不过别聊{i}我{/i}了。我的故事又长又乱，而我想多了解了解你。Sana 一聊到她的朋友就不太肯开口。

lines.en: : Ayane’s really the only one I know anything about. And even that’s mostly surface level stuff.
lines.zh: : Ayane 大概是我唯一了解一点的人。而且连那些也大多只是表面上的东西。

lines.en: scene rinsara35
: I don’t mind opening up. You seem like a good person. I’m just-
lines.zh: : 我不介意敞开心扉。你看起来是个好人。我只是——

lines.en: : Not sure what you can tell me since it’s the first time we’ve really talked and you don’t fully trust that it’ll stay between us?
lines.zh: : 只是不确定能跟我说什么，毕竟这是我们第一次真正聊天，你也不完全相信这些话会只留在我们俩之间？

lines.en: : Something...like that.
lines.zh: : 差不多……是这样。

lines.en: : I’m sure I’d have said the same thing in your shoes. My experience with adults when I was younger wasn’t exactly great.
lines.zh: : 我要是处在你的位置，肯定也会这么想。我小时候跟大人打交道的经历可不怎么美好。

lines.en: : It’s not that I have bad experiences with adults or anything. There’s just...a lot of stuff I know that could mess up basically {i}everything{/i} if it gets out.
lines.zh: : 倒不是我跟大人有什么不好的经历。只是……我知道的很多事一旦泄露出去，基本上能把{i}一切{/i}搞砸。

lines.en: : And it’s gotten to the point where I have to think like, five times more carefully about every single thing I say so nothing is ruined.
lines.zh: : 而且现在已经到了这种地步：我说的每一句话都得比以前多掂量五倍，才能不把事情搞坏。

lines.en: : I’m going to have to start keeping a notebook soon. I can barely remember who knows what at this point. Like, half the class probably doesn’t even know I kissed Sana yet.
lines.zh: : 我很快就得开始记笔记了。到现在我几乎记不清谁知道什么。比如，全班大概有一半人还不知道我吻过 Sana 呢。

lines.en: scene rinsara36
: You what?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : See?! Fuck! I didn’t last five seconds! There’s no room in my stupid brain for any more secrets! This is getting too hard!
lines.zh: : 你看？！操！我五秒都没撑住！我这破脑子再也装不下更多秘密了！这太难了！

lines.en: : You...kissed Sana?
lines.zh: : 你……吻了 Sana？

lines.en: scene rinsara37
: No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : That was a lie.
lines.zh: : 那是骗你的。

lines.en: : Why are you lying about lying?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要对自己的谎话撒谎？

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about. Anyway, time to move on.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。总之，换个话题吧。

lines.en: : Are you two...dating?
lines.zh: : 你们两个……在交往？

lines.en: scene rinsara38
: What?! No no no no no! It’s nothing like that! In fact, it’s nothing at all! But if it was {i}anything{/i} at all, which it’s not, it would have just been...like...a Christmas party thing.
lines.zh: : 什么？！不不不不不！完全不是那么回事！事实上，什么都不是！可就算真的有{i}什么{/i}（其实并没有），那也只是……那个……圣诞派对上的事而已。

lines.en: scene rinsara39
: Huh.
: Uhh...{i}please{/i} don’t mention this to her. I don’t want her to think I...blabbed about anything else.
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}请{/i}别跟她说这个。我不想让她觉得我……把别的事也抖出去了。

lines.en: : I won’t mention anything, don’t worry. I’m just not really sure how I feel about...finding this out from {i}you{/i} instead of her.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不会说，别担心。我只是不太确定自己该怎么想……这件事是从{i}你{/i}嘴里听来的，而不是从她那里。

lines.en: : I’m not sure what I was expecting, though. It’s not like she ever opens up about anything in the first place.
lines.zh: : 不过我也不确定自己本来在期待什么。她本来就从不对任何事敞开心扉。

lines.en: : I swear, between her and Sensei it’s like I’m constantly trying to pry open a locked diary. So hearing you accidentally confess things like that is a breath of fresh air, weirdly enough.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，夹在她和 Sensei 中间，感觉就像我一直在试图撬开一本上了锁的日记。所以听你这样不小心说漏嘴，说来也怪，反倒让人耳目一新。

lines.en: : You’re...close with Sensei too?
lines.zh: : 你……也跟 Sensei 很亲近？

lines.en: scene rinsara40
: I like to think so...but I can’t help but question it at times. Especially lately.
lines.zh: : 我愿意这么想……但有时候也忍不住怀疑。尤其是最近。

lines.en: : We’ve got that in common, then. It’s kind of embarrassing to say this, but...Sensei’s kind of, like...tied for the role of my best friend.
lines.zh: : 那我们还挺有共同点的。说起来有点难为情，但……Sensei 差不多……算是我「最好的朋友」的并列人选吧。

lines.en: : Like, he knows things about me that even my roommate doesn’t and I’ve been with her since middle school.
lines.zh: : 就是说，他知道的关于我的事，连我室友都不知道，而我从初中就和她在一起了。

lines.en: : Does {i}he{/i} know you kissed my daughter? Because I can’t fault you for keeping it a secret, but I can sure as heck blame him.
lines.zh: : {i}他{/i}知道你吻了我女儿吗？因为你想保密我没法怪你，但我绝对可以怪他。

lines.en: : I’m just going to do that thing where I laugh and avoid the question. Hahaha. Ha.
lines.zh: : 我就打算哈哈一笑，把这个问题糊弄过去。哈哈哈。哈。

lines.en: : You’re funny. I can see why my daughter kissed you.
lines.zh: : 你真有意思。我明白我女儿为什么会吻你了。

lines.en: : Okay, we can stop bringing that up now.
lines.zh: : 行了，这事可以别再提了。

lines.en: : Do you like her? Be honest.
lines.zh: : 你喜欢她吗？说实话。

lines.en: scene rinsara41
: Sana? No! It’s...It’s nothing against her. Like, she’s a great friend and an awesome girl. But I don’t think the two of us...
lines.zh: : Sana？不！这……这不是针对她。她是个很好的朋友，也是个很棒的女孩。但我觉得我们俩……

lines.en: : I don’t really feel that way about her. She was just one of many casualties in this year’s game of spin the bottle.
lines.zh: : 我对她没有那种感觉。她只是今年这场转瓶游戏里众多「伤者」之一。

lines.en: : Darn. And here I was hoping for a second daughter.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。我还指望能再有个女儿呢。

lines.en: scene rinsara40
: Sorry to disappoint you. I don’t think either of my moms would be happy if I abandoned them for you, though.
lines.zh: : 抱歉让你失望了。不过我要是为了你抛下她们，我那两位妈妈大概都不会开心。

lines.en: : Hey, you’ve already got two. What’s one more?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你都已经有两个了。再多一个又怎样？

lines.en: : Good point. Plus, it’d be four counting my bio-mom. And five if we want to throw Haruka into the mix as my work mom. How many more do you think I need before setting some kind of record?
lines.zh: : 有道理。再说，算上我生母就是四个。要是再把 Haruka 算成我的「工作妈妈」，就是五个。你觉得我还得凑够几个才能破个什么纪录？

lines.en: : So you’re the...adopted child of two women? I was wondering what you meant by that “double the experience with moms” thing.
lines.zh: : 所以你是……被两个女人收养的孩子？我还在想你说的「跟妈妈打交道的经验多一倍」是什么意思。

lines.en: : You could’ve just asked, you know. It’s not really a thing I hide. I love my parents.
lines.zh: : 你其实可以直接问的，知道吗。这又不是我刻意要隐瞒的事。我爱我的父母。

lines.en: : Not everyone does, though. And that can be a touchy subject for a lot of people. {i}Especially{/i} people you barely know.
lines.zh: : 不过也不是人人都爱。而且这对很多人来说都可能是个敏感话题。{i}尤其是{/i}对几乎不认识的人。

lines.en: scene rinsara42
: Good point. But even the touchy stuff like my biological parents doesn’t really get to me the way most people expect it to.
lines.zh: : 有道理。不过就连亲生父母这种敏感话题，其实也没像大多数人预想的那样刺痛我。

lines.en: : Then, do you mind if I just come out and blatantly ask what could possibly compel a couple to give up someone as cute as you?
lines.zh: : 那我能不能就直截了当地问一句：到底是什么原因，能让一对夫妻放弃像你这么可爱的孩子？

lines.en: : Beats me. My skull was still all soft and weird back then.
lines.zh: : 我哪儿知道。那时候我的头骨还又软又奇怪呢。

lines.en: : All I know is that my bio-mom was clinically insane and my dad...is a human being who exists. Or {i}existed.{/i} He’s the biggest question mark in my life, to be completely honest.
lines.zh: : 我只知道我生母是临床意义上的疯子，而我爸……是一个存在着的人。或者说{i}存在过{/i}。老实说，他是我人生中最大的一个问号。

lines.en: scene rinsara43
: Probably just another jerk like Sana’s dad — some guy who runs off before he ever has the chance to realize how wonderful his daughter is.
lines.zh: : 大概也只是另一个像 Sana 爸爸那样的混蛋——某个还没来得及意识到自己女儿有多好就跑掉的男人。

lines.en: : Probably. No use in turning over any stones to find out, though. Not when I have a trillion other issues that need addressing first.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过翻石头去找答案也没什么意义。何况我还有一万亿个别的问题要先解决。

lines.en: scene rinsara44
: Well, hey...
lines.zh: : 那个，嘿……

lines.en: : If your three other good moms are ever busy and you’re in need of a fourth one to accidentally spill more of your secrets to...
lines.zh: : 要是你那三位好妈妈都忙，而你需要第四位妈妈好不小心再抖出更多秘密……

lines.en: : You know where my bar is.
lines.zh: : 你知道我的酒吧在哪儿。

lines.en: : Only if you’re comfortable with it, though. I get that we might be moving a little quickly right now. I’m just a little weak when it comes to Sana and her friends.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是你愿意。我知道我们现在可能进展有点快。我只是对 Sana 和她的朋友们特别没辙。

lines.en: : Especially friends that might turn into {i}more than friends{/i} if they keep kissing at Christmas parties.
lines.zh: : 尤其是那种要是一直在圣诞派对上亲来亲去，说不定就会从朋友变成{i}不止于朋友{/i}的人。

lines.en: scene rinsara45
: Okay. I would like the taxi to arrive now.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我希望出租车现在就到。

lines.en: : Hahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene black
The night is far from over as Rin and Sara wait for their car to arrive.
lines.zh: Rin 和 Sara 等着车来，这一夜还远没有结束。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
But that doesn’t stop someone miles away from putting an end to it early.
lines.zh: 但这并不妨碍远在数英里之外的某个人提前为它画上句号。

lines.en: : I hope tomorrow is better than today.
lines.zh: : 希望明天会比今天好过些。

lines.en: scene black
He collapses into the bed.
lines.zh: 他倒在床上。

lines.en: He accepts that it won’t be.
lines.zh: 他接受了这个事实：并不会。

lines.en: {i}Rin and Sara are now friends!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 和 Sara 现在是朋友了！{/i}
